title: Healing the Beloved Country: The Faith of Julia Mavimbela
author: Matthew K. Heiss
section: Learning to Listen: The First Racially Integrated Branches in South Africa

footnotes.text: Except as noted, accounts and quotations come from Laura Harper, “‘Mother of Soweto’: Julia Mavimbela, Apartheid Peace-Maker and Latter-day Saint,” unpublished manuscript, Church History Library, Salt Lake City.
In the Harper text, the wordlampis used instead oflump. However, Julia’s daughter Thoba confirmed that the word inscribed on the grave marker waslump.
From David Lawrence McCombs, interview with author, Aug. 25, 2015.
Dale G. Renlund, “Latter-day Saints Keep on Trying,”Liahona,May 2015, 57.
